info.title: API.SH: Zacks
info.description: The Zacks API from API.SH: public Zacks data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits

get.summary: Usage per day and per endpoint
get.description: Calls, errors and credits per UTC day, and the top endpoints by credits. Free. Add output=csv for the daily rows as CSV.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: status

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Next earnings report date with consensus and Earnings ESP, and the history of earnings and sales announcements (estimate, reported, surprise, time), company guidance, recent estimate revisions by analyst, dividends, stock splits and earnings call transcript links.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zacks-earnings

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Detailed estimates for a stock: EPS summary, sales and earnings estimates for the current and next quarter and year (consensus, number of estimates, high, low, year-ago), estimate revisions, consensus trend, most accurate estimate versus consensus, and reported earnings surprises.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zacks-estimates

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

upside_most_accurate_estimate_versus_zac.title: Upside - Most Accurate Estimate Versus Zacks Consensus

get.description:
How a stock compares with its industry and the S&P 500: industry, top peers, recommendation and estimates, growth rates and financial ratios side by side.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zacks-industry-comparison

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Delayed quotes for up to 20 tickers: last price, change, previous close, open, day and 52-week range, volume, market cap, P/E and forward P/E, EPS, beta, dividend and yield, pre/after-market price, the Zacks Rank (1 Strong Buy to 5 Strong Sell) and the expected earnings date. Unknown tickers are listed in `unknown`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zacks-quote

parameters.name: ticker
parameters.description: One or more tickers, comma-separated, e.g. `AAPL,MSFT`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Analyst price targets (average, high, low, upside), brokerage recommendation counts over the last three months, and recent analyst rating and price target changes (date, brokerage, analyst, rating, target, previous rating and target).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zacks-recommendations

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The stocks a predefined screen returns today, with the screen's columns (e.g. price, P/E, volume, industry, market cap). The Zacks Rank column is a premium value and comes back null.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zacks-screen

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Screen id from `/zacks/v1/screens`, e.g. `48224` (low P/E stocks).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The free predefined stock screens (basic and thematic): id, type, name and link. Use an id with `/zacks/v1/screen`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zacks-screens

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Find stocks, ETFs and funds by ticker or company name: ticker, name, type, sector and link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zacks-search

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A stock's research summary: Zacks Rank, Style Scores (Value, Growth, Momentum, VGM), industry with its Zacks Industry Rank, stock activity (open, ranges, average volume, market cap, dividend, beta), key earnings data (Earnings ESP, most accurate and consensus estimates, expected report date, EPS growth, forward P/E, PEG) and the style scorecards comparing the stock with its industry and peers.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zacks-stock

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
